harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up filesystem-snapshot-backed recoverability for /srv/data on node1 (RHEL9, single-disk, no spare block device or LVM originally present): created a loopback-backed LVM volume group/logical volume mounted at /srv/data, made this persistent across reboot via a systemd oneshot unit (srv-data-setup.service). Populated application data, took an LVM snapshot (datalv_snap_baseline), corrupted/deleted/added files to simulate a bad change, then rolled back exactly to the snapshot state via `lvconvert --merge`, verified byte-for-byte match via sha256sum. Took a fresh ongoing snapshot (datalv_snap_current) for continued recoverability. Completed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the mount, systemd unit, LVM snapshot, and data checksums all recovered identically post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk layout (XFS root/boot, no LVM, no spare block device)
Installed lvm2 package
Created 8G loopback backing file and attached /dev/loop0
Created LVM PV/VG(datavg)/LV(datalv, 5G) and XFS filesystem, mounted at /srv/data

Created /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-setup.sh and systemd unit srv-data-setup.service (WantedBy=local-fs.target) to reattach loop device, activate VG, and mount /srv/data on every boot; enabled and validated the unit
Populated /srv/data/app with sample application files and computed baseline sha256 checksums
Took LVM snapshot datalv_snap_baseline capturing this state
Modified /srv/data (corrupted file1, deleted file2, added junk.txt)
Unmounted /srv/data and ran `lvconvert --merge` to roll back the origin LV to the snapshot content
Remounted /srv/data and verified sha256 checksums matched the pre-modification baseline exactly
Took a new snapshot (datalv_snap_current) to preserve ongoing recoverability
Captured pre-restart boot_id and verified healthy state (mount, service, data, snapshot)
Issued `systemctl reboot` on node1, polled until the node reconnected
Verified boot_id changed after restart
Verified post-restart recovery: systemd unit active, /srv/data mounted, LVM VG/LV/snapshot present, data checksums identical to baseline

evidence.requirement: Baseline application data and healthy state captured before any snapshot/restart activity
evidence.summary: Created /srv/data on a new LVM LV, populated files, computed baseline sha256 checksums
lvcreate --snapshot datalv_snap_baseline created against datalv while content matched baseline checksums

evidence.requirement: Directory modified after snapshot (simulating corruption/data loss)
evidence.summary: file1.txt overwritten, file2.txt deleted, junk.txt added; checksums diverge from baseline

evidence.requirement: Exact restoration of earlier snapshot content
evidence.summary: lvconvert --merge rolled datalv back to snapshot state; post-restore sha256sum diff against baseline file showed MATCH

evidence.requirement: Ongoing snapshot-based recoverability preserved going forward
evidence.summary: New snapshot datalv_snap_current created after restore; persistence unit srv-data-setup.service verified enabled and active

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline captured before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 55595e92... plus mount, data checksums, LVM state, and service status prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and boot identity change
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued (ack returned before disconnect), node unreachable during reboot, then reconnected with new boot_id 7fc89896... confirming an actual restart

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required services and data
evidence.summary: After reboot, loop device reattached, datavg activated, /srv/data mounted via srv-data-setup.service (active), snapshot datalv_snap_current intact, and file checksums matched the original baseline exactly (MATCH_POSTBOOT)
